queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'NVDA %' AND publisher = 'NV Access';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'NVDA %' AND publisher = 'NV Access' AND version_compare(version, '2026.1.1') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'nvda.exe');
